questions.question: Fallback lines in capture.mjs (when stdin isn't valid JSON) have no captured_at timestamp. What should I do about it?

options.label: Add timestamp (Recommended)
options.description: Add captured_at to the fallback line so every line in ask-capture.jsonl has the same format.

options.label: Add timestamp + tests
options.description: Add the timestamp and a node:test file that covers valid and invalid stdin.
